title: Meeting summaries
description: Metadata for the six processed meetings in #meeting-summaries. The PROSE lives in separate HTML partials referenced by the *_file fields, not in this JSON: the September 14 detailed summary alone is roughly 4,000 words of nested markup, which as a JSON string would be one unreadable escaped line. Within a single meeting the date and recording URL currently appear five times (disclaimer, three panel headers, transcript footer); here they appear once.

$schema.description: Relative path to this schema file.

section_intro.description: Lead paragraph above the meeting selector buttons.

meetings.description: SELECTOR ORDER IS ARRAY ORDER. Worth stating because the pre-refactor page had the buttons in one order and the panel markup in another; generating both from this array makes them agree by construction.

id.description: Stable slug, e.g. 'town-council-sep2026'. Becomes the data-meeting attribute on both the selector button and its panel set; the UI test asserts those two always match.

governing_body.description: Foreign key to bodies.json id. Build fails on a dangling reference.

selector.description: The two lines printed on the selector button. An object because the button renders them as separate styled spans, not one string.

title.description: Single-line full title used by the JavaScript placeholder fallback and by the AI prompt. Derivable from selector + date; store it only if you want to override the derived form.

date.description: Meeting date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Every displayed date string is formatted from this -- it is currently written out by hand in five places per meeting.

duration_min.description: Recording length in minutes, shown in the exec panel header.

chair.description: Attendance line: 'Supervisor Mohan (chair) . Town Council', or noting who was absent. NOTE: cross-check this against the summary body -- the audit found a July meeting whose header implied one absence while the detailed summary named two, which contradicted the recorded 6-0 vote.

icon.description: Emoji shown beside the body name in the panel header.

recording_url.description: Official recording. Hosts differ per body (CivicClerk, YouTube, Vimeo, Swagit) so this cannot be templated from the body.

minutes_url.description: Official posted minutes or agenda centre for this body.

disclaimer_extra.description: Meeting-specific addition to the standard 'AI-generated - not official records' banner. The September 14 Town Council entry uses this for its poor-audio caveat. The standard sentence itself is a build template, not repeated here.

transcript_footer.description: The italic note under the transcript. Genuinely varies -- three different versions exist, covering Whisper attribution, name correction against a verified roster, and passages left out rather than guessed at.

status.description: 'published' emits a full panel set; 'processing' emits the placeholder. CAUTION: tests/ui.spec.js asserts that EVERY selector opens a real panel set and never the placeholder, so adding a 'processing' meeting fails the suite unless the build omits its selector or that test is relaxed. Decide before using this value.

exec_summary_file.description: Path to the Executive Summary partial (headline paragraphs, key votes, action items table).

detailed_summary_file.description: Path to the Detailed Summary partial (timestamped sections).

transcript_file.description: Path to the transcript partial (timestamped speaker blocks). All three are null while status is 'processing'.
